parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Valid values:

- DESC (default): descending order.

- ASC: ascending order.

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description:
The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
><warning>If the query time range is large and the domain name has a large volume of resolution logs, the query may time out or return inaccurate results.></warning>

parameters.name: GrowType
parameters.description: Used for the report on subdomains with sudden increases or decreases in request volume.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
The sort parameter. Valid values:
- createDate: sorts by creation time. This is the default value if this parameter is left empty.
- expireDate: sorts by expiration time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The sampling period. Valid values:

- DAY: day.

- WEEK: week.

- MONTH: month.

parameters.name: ServerRegion
parameters.description: The region of the resolution cluster.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description: The route type. Valid values: cloud: cloud route. local: on-premises route.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
